category: uptime, SSL, DNS, port and domain monitoring with status pages

free_tier.stated: Free plan: 20 monitors at a 5-minute interval, 1 status page with a custom domain, HTTPS, SSL, domain name, DNS and port monitoring, email alerts to 1 recipient, Telegram, Pushover, Slack and Discord alerts and 2 webhook alerts
free_tier.notes: The unit counted is the monitor. The paid plans carry a 14-day free trial: Indie is EUR 5 a month for 50 monitors at 1-minute checks and Pro is EUR 20 a month for 200 monitors at 30-second checks.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: a monitor checks a target; nothing is stored per object

retention.stated: unverified: no history retention period is stated on the pricing page

egress.terms: not applicable: an outbound checker; no export or API access is named on the pricing page

interface_detail: The pricing page names no API for any plan, so the Free plan is reached through the web app and its alert channels; the interface vocabulary has no term for a browser-only service.
tooling: the web app, public status pages and the alert channels
chaining: External HTTPS, SSL, DNS and port checks every 5 minutes on up to 20 endpoints of free-hosted services, with Telegram, Slack, Discord or webhook alerts and one status page on a custom domain.
limits_note: Free has 1 status page, 1 email alert recipient and 2 webhook alerts.
binding_note: The 5-minute interval sets the detection delay of every monitor and binds before the 20-monitor cap for an app that needs faster detection.

identity_cost.detail: The register form asks for a first name, a last name, an email address and a password; the pricing page states no credit card term for the Free plan, whose button is Get Started where the paid plans say Start Free Trial. Whether a later step asks for a card or a phone number is unverified: behind a sign-up.

reliability_note: no throttle, ban or data loss is stated on the pages read
confidence_note: Plan limits are quoted from the first-party pricing page and the sign-up fields from the register page. No account was opened, so the card term and later steps are unverified: behind a sign-up.
